description: This Java interface defines the contract for a device management service within the Eclipse Hono project. It specifies methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting device registration data, utilizing asynchronous handlers and spans for tracing.

classes.name: DeviceManagementService
classes.description: An interface providing methods for managing device registration lifecycle, supporting registration, retrieval, update, and deregistration of devices.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Registers a new device with specified details and handles asynchronous result, including tracing span info.

methods.name: readDevice
methods.description: Retrieves device registration data asynchronously, supporting tracing.

methods.name: updateDevice
methods.description: Updates registration information for a device asynchronously, with resource version control.

methods.name: deleteDevice
methods.description: Removes a device registration asynchronously, with support for resource versioning and tracing.
